title: Proof — we have run furniture factories, not just campaigns
meta_description: A 50,000 sq.ft manufacturing floor, three factories operated, ₹87 Cr+ of annual sales handled. What BrandSure has actually done.

sections.headline: We learned this by running furniture businesses.
sections.body: Not by reading about them. Every agency you have spoken to can run an ad. Very few of them have had to make the sofa, sell it and deliver it.

sections.headline: One business, five months.
sections.context: A furniture business in its twenty-sixth year, with a factory and a showroom already working.

sections.headline: Why there is only one number on this page.
paragraphs: Because there is only one result we can stand behind completely, and we would rather show you that than a wall of logos.
When there are more, they will appear here with the same caveat attached. Anything we cannot show you honestly, we will tell you about in the conversation instead.
